name: Remotion ProRes 4444 Alpha Overlay Export
use_when: A Remotion text, title, lower-third, glow, mask wipe, or transition element needs to be imported into an editor or composited later.
The overlay has soft edges, blur, glow, antialiasing, or semi-transparent pixels.
The agent needs a reusable alpha asset rather than a final social MP4.
avoid_when: The user only needs an opaque final export.
The receiving tool cannot handle ProRes alpha.
A tiny browser-playback file matters more than editor compatibility.
The Remotion composition has an opaque background that has not been fixed.

timeline_pattern.pattern: Remotion_component -> checkerboard_transparency_preflight -> png_frame_render -> prores_4444_yuva444p10le -> import_or_ffmpeg_overlay -> alpha_edge_qc
timeline_pattern.background_rule: Root composition and wrappers must not paint a background when exporting alpha.
timeline_pattern.handoff_rule: Name reusable overlay files with effect, resolution, fps, duration, and alpha status.

motion.rule: Export duration and fps must match the intended timeline window exactly so overlay timing does not drift.

keyframe_values.short_text_reveal: 6-15 frames at 30 fps for fast short-form text wipes.
keyframe_values.lower_third_or_title: 12-24 frames at 30 fps for calmer editor overlays.
keyframe_values.hold: Add enough readable hold after reveal before the overlay clears.

sound.rule: No sound is embedded unless the overlay is explicitly a sound-synced bumper; SFX should usually stay in the main edit for mix control.

captions.rule: If the overlay carries spoken words, mark ordinary captions for suppression or repositioning in the receiving timeline.

color.rule: Check alpha edges over bright and dark backgrounds so glow or antialiasing is not contaminated by black or white fringes.

implementation.ffmpeg: After export, validate with ffprobe and composite with overlay=format=auto or an alpha-preserving path; if converting from image sequences, use prores_ks with yuva444p10le for alpha.
implementation.remotion: Render with --image-format=png --codec=prores --prores-profile=4444 --pixel-format=yuva444p10le and keep the composition background transparent.
implementation.blender: Render RGBA image sequences or ProRes 4444 with transparent film enabled, then inspect alpha edges before handoff.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Import the transparent ProRes overlay above footage if supported; otherwise composite externally before bringing in the final opaque render.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Import the ProRes 4444 .mov above footage and do not chroma key it; if it appears black, inspect alpha interpretation and codec settings.

common_mistakes: Exporting transparent Remotion graphics as ordinary MP4.
Leaving an invisible-looking but opaque root background in the composition.
Using WebM alpha as an editor handoff without testing editor support.
Assuming a black background means alpha is working.
Letting overlay duration differ from the intended edit window.
qc: Checkerboard is visible in empty Remotion canvas areas before render.
ffprobe or equivalent confirms an alpha-capable output.
A sampled empty pixel outside the graphic is transparent, not black.
Overlay imports above footage without chroma keying.
Glow and antialiased edges remain clean over bright and dark backgrounds.
